fields.description: DAMAC Islands 2 is an off-plan villa and townhouse community in Dubailand, arranged around eight island-inspired clusters. Homes include different townhouse, twin-villa and detached-villa formats within a landscape-led masterplan. It is distinct from the original DAMAC Islands development.

overview: The brochure presents several home formats, including mid and end townhouses, a twin villa and a larger detached villa. Its interior palette uses porcelain finishes, veneer and metal detailing. It explicitly permits equivalent material substitutions and states that illustrated furniture is not included.
research.locationNote: DAMAC locates Islands 2 in Dubailand. The community includes Bahamas, Tahiti, Bermuda, Barbados, Cuba, Maui, Mauritius and Antigua clusters. Check the selected release, plot and approved access route; this record covers the wider Islands 2 development rather than original Islands phases.
research.priceNote: The dated Bermuda flyer starts at AED 2.75m for four-bedroom townhouses, AED 3.57m for five-bedroom townhouses, AED 5m for five-bedroom twin villas and AED 9.70m for six-bedroom villas. These are release-specific launch references; current offers and other clusters may differ.
research.paymentNote: The reviewed Bermuda launch sheet collects 20% immediately, 55% over construction instalments and 25% on completion. Its detailed month groups appear below. It adds 4% DLD to the initial deposit. Obtain the schedule for the actual cluster and selected home before relying on these historical terms.
research.handoverNote: The Bermuda sheet estimates 30 June 2030, shown here asQ 2 2030. This is not a verified completion date for every Islands 2 cluster; contractual schedules and later releases require separate confirmation.
